svg.title: Same learning in half the time
svg.desc: Training loss over a full Nestor-100M run (19,080 updates, identical batches), timed at each implementation's measured speed on the same H100: Latch 8.2 h, the authors' PyTorch 17.4 h.
svg.text: Same learning in half the time
2.1× less time to the same training loss. Nestor-100M, 19,080 updates, 5B tokens.
Training loss on identical batches, timed at each implementation's measured speed on the same H100.
